summarize_show_versions: summarize the python function show_versions to display system and dependency information for bug reports
test_show_versions_json: test the python function show_versions with as_json=True to output system and dependency info as JSON to stdout
run_show_versions_file: run the python function show_versions with as_json set to a file path to write version info as JSON
review_get_commit_hash: review the python function _get_commit_hash to retrieve the git commit hash from versioneer
build_get_dependency_info: build a call to _get_dependency_info to collect installed package versions including pandas and optional dependencies
